final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_units_invoiced, AVG(1.0 * (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_calculated_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY average_units_invoiced DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_units_invoiced, average_calculated_ratio, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3
